column1: # EXCLUDED.tsv -- rosetta-unicon: the programs this package ships and does not grade, one row a program: name<TAB>CLASS<TAB>evidence,

column3: KEPT OUT ON LON'S WORD (2026-11-17 17:4x CST, in the cio's window, verbatim: "Do not worry about network programs. Just exclude them."; the cqo): an HTTP GET of the URL it is given. Before: NEEDS-NETWORK: http.icn is open(arglist[1], "m") and a read loop, an HTTP GET of the URL it is given; with no argument the oracle prints nothing and exits 0 (an empty answer, which the builder refuses as vacuous). MEASURED 2026-11-17 on unicon 13.3 (officer_04): with a local python http.server on 127.0.0.1 answering curl, the oracle's open of http://127.0.0.1:PORT/index.html and http://localhost:PORT/index.html in mode m fails error 1206 unknown host and the server log shows no request from it, so no fixture a graded run could stage makes the program print a page; a real run needs a remote web host (row packages-owed-rosetta-unicon-measured-declared-or-cut)

KEPT OUT ON LON'S WORD (2026-11-17 17:4x CST, in the cio's window, verbatim: "Do not worry about network programs.
